title: Bandgap core schematic-entry smoke check: untrimmed nominal operating point
claim: Schematic-entry bring-up for issue #8 -- NOT the output-accuracy spec claim. Substantiates that design/bandgap_core.sch (Kuijk-style core + design/error_amp.sch) netlists headlessly through this harness, biases up out of its degenerate state, closes its loop (the amplifier's input-referred error at the sense nodes is microvolts, not millivolts), and produces an untrimmed reference in the vicinity of 1.20 V at tt / 27 degC / 3.30 V. The +/-1% output-accuracy claim over the full PVT matrix is issue #11's experiment, not this one; trim is #13 and the offset-budget amplifier is #9.
statistical_convention: N/A (single-point operating-point check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: vref
measurements.note: Untrimmed reference output, open circuit. Deliberately a few-percent sanity band around 1.20 V, NOT the +/-1% spec window -- that claim needs the full PVT matrix and belongs to issue #11.

measurements.name: vos_loop
measurements.note: Residual difference across the two matched R2 legs' bottom nodes -- the error the amplifier fails to null. Sub-millivolt means the loop is actually regulating; if the core sat in its degenerate zero-current state or the loop polarity were inverted, this would be tens of millivolts or more.

measurements.name: vgdrv
measurements.note: PMOS mirror gate / startup attachment node. Explicit degenerate-state guard: the all-off solution parks this node at VDD, so an upper bound below the supply fails loudly instead of silently reporting a plausible-looking zero.

measurements.name: vbe_ctat
measurements.note: CTAT term: emitter voltage of the small-unit PNP array Q1 (base and collector at VSS, so this is VEB). Cross-checks against design/device-characterization-summary.md section 1.

measurements.name: dvbe
measurements.note: PTAT term developed across R1 by the PNP pair's emitter-area ratio. Window spans the -40..125 degC range measured in design/device-characterization-summary.md section 1 (47.8 .. 82.2 mV).

measurements.name: isup
measurements.note: Total quiescent supply current (core branches + amplifier). Upper bound is the < 50 uA Iq budget the device-characterization summary sizes against.

notes: spread_checks is empty on purpose: a corner-sensitivity check needs at least two corner points, and this experiment's committed record is a deliberate single-point run (see the record's subset reason). The full-matrix run with spread checks is issue #11's job; the harness's own corner-liveness proof lives in sim/pdk-smoke/.
The corner axes above declare the full PVT matrix this experiment would sweep, so a later full run needs no manifest edit -- only dropping --quick.
